motion.name: fast
motion.purpose: Hover, press, tooltip, and exit feedback.

motion.name: celestial
motion.purpose: Authored constellation and milestone set pieces.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Compact, confident primary action with a quiet tactile press.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { border: 0; border-radius: .625rem; background: var(--primary, #0f3d3e); color: var(--primary-foreground, #e8f3f1); padding: .5rem .75rem; font: 500 .875rem/1.25 Outfit, sans-serif; transition: background-color 120ms, translate 120ms; } .ds-button-primary:hover { filter: brightness(.92); } .ds-button-primary:active { translate: 0 1px; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ring, #0f3d3e) 50%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: A quiet secondary action on the current surface.
components.css: .ds-button-outline { border: 1px solid var(--border, #e4e7e1); border-radius: .625rem; background: var(--background, #fbfbf9); color: var(--foreground, #1a1c1a); padding: .5rem .75rem; font: 500 .875rem/1.25 Outfit, sans-serif; transition: background-color 120ms; } .ds-button-outline:hover { background: var(--muted, #f0f2ee); } .ds-button-outline:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ring, #0f3d3e) 50%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Input
components.description: Compact transparent field with an explicit focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 16rem; height: 2rem; border: 1px solid var(--input, #e4e7e1); border-radius: .625rem; background: transparent; color: var(--foreground, #1a1c1a); padding: .25rem .625rem; font: 400 .875rem/1.5 Outfit, sans-serif; } .ds-input:focus { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ring, #0f3d3e) 45%, transparent); border-color: var(--ring, #0f3d3e); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Soft, lightly outlined operating surface with no decorative lift.
components.css: .ds-card { width: 18rem; border-radius: .875rem; background: var(--card, #fff); color: var(--card-foreground, #1a1c1a); padding: 1rem; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground, #1a1c1a) 10%, transparent); font: 400 .875rem/1.5 Outfit, sans-serif; } .ds-card strong { font: 500 1rem/1.3 Fraunces, Georgia, serif; } .ds-card p { color: var(--muted-foreground, #5f6760); margin: .35rem 0 0; }

components.name: Active Navigation Pill
components.description: A softly raised shared-element state inside liquid-glass navigation.
components.html: Dashboard
components.css: .ds-nav-active { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .625rem; border-radius: .75rem; background: rgba(255,255,255,.7); color: var(--sidebar-accent-foreground, #0f3d3e); padding: .5rem .75rem; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.08); font: 400 .875rem/1.25 Outfit, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-active:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ring, #0f3d3e) 50%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: Orbit pairs a calm, practical relationship workspace with moments of genuine celestial scale. Everyday app surfaces stay light, legible, and restrained; meaningful milestones may open into deep space, saturated plan colors, and authored motion.
keyCharacteristics: Quiet operating surfaces with selective atmospheric depth.
Fraunces for framing and Outfit for operation.
Teal, blue, and gold carry distinct semantic roles.
Snappy routine feedback and slower celestial motion for earned moments.

rules.name: The Earned Color Rule
rules.body: Blue and gold may drench a surface only when the state itself is the subject.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Fraunces names and frames; Outfit explains and operates.

rules.name: The Flat-Until-Meaningful Rule
rules.body: Elevation appears for interaction, persistent floating navigation, or celestial depth.

dos: Do reserve celestial spectacle for landing, constellation, onboarding, and genuinely earned milestones.
Do keep routine transitions within the fast/base motion tier and use the house easing curve for authored arrivals.
Do preserve strong written hierarchy and reduced-motion behavior whenever color and motion become expressive.
donts: Don't scatter blue and gold together as generic decoration; each has a plan and hierarchy role.
Don't replace the product's connected-star language with generic confetti, trophies, or arcade badges.
Don't stack blur, glow, gradients, and shadows unless each layer communicates depth or state.
